title: Stabilize Rossovia theory, architecture, and skill expressions

mainline.contradiction: The stable Principle Sequence has resisted churn, but purpose, architecture, always-loaded guidance, and Skill evidence are not layered strongly enough for theory to guide concrete work without recent control mechanisms dominating attention.
acceptance: Distinguish external reality, human mandate, Principle Sequence, accepted architecture, Skills, situated formations, execution mechanisms, and evidence without transferring authority between them.
Retain or propose Principle changes through source-bound review; no Sequence semantic change occurs without an explicit Principal decision.
Review every active Skill for ownership, lineage, context placement, and behavior evidence, then repair only material gaps.
Keep root agent guidance compact while preserving scoped Workbench commands and authority boundaries through an explicit activation path.
Verify the exact candidate structurally and behaviorally and obtain fresh independent review before an unmerged integration handoff.

branches.purpose: Reconstruct the governing stack from historical evidence, clarify derivative theory where it drifted, compact always-loaded guidance, and close the highest-value Skill evidence gaps.
branches.returnCondition: The exact branch head has passed scoped structure and behavior checks, fresh independent review, and is handed off through an unmerged stacked pull request or an explicit blocked-integration report.

branches.purpose: Determine which prompt components, orderings, repetitions, and language forms reproducibly create a useful object-to-relation-to-judgment-to-action reasoning path; identify removal candidates, and remove one only after matched ablation preserves named checkpoints and hard boundaries across the declared evidence range.
branches.returnCondition: A reconstructable multi-task, matched Chinese-English evaluation separates predicate, composition, ordering, and transfer effects; skill-engineering retains only supported methods and records unresolved model-specific limits.
